input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Developer, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including parallel account info, order info, record, account info. The platform provides capabilities for ktv, abstract sms, sms. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Developer, I want to create and manage parallel account info records, so that I can track and organize parallel account info data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage order info records, so that I can track and organize order info data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage record records, so that I can track and organize record data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage account info records, so that I can track and organize account info data effectively.
As a Developer, I want to create and manage page task records, so that I can track and organize page task data effectively.
